item.title: KIWG 2026: ITBP Win Women’s Ice-hockey Gold; Haryana Remain On Top
item.description: Khelo India Winter Games: Ladakh ran out of luck as ITBP women reclaimed the Khelo India Winter Games ice-hockey gold at the Nawang Dorjay Stobdan (NDS) Stadium on Sunday evening.

item.title: 'It's A Very Big Moment For Me': Harmanpreet Kaur On Being Honoured With Padma Shri
item.description: Padma Shri Award: Indian women’s team captain Harmanpreet Kaur described her Padma Shri honour as a “very big moment” in her career.

item.title: HIL 2026 Qualifier 2: Tom Boon’s Hat-Trick Powers Ranchi Royals to Final With Win Over Hyderabad Toofans
item.description: Ranchi Royals defeated Hyderabad Toofans 3-2 in Qualifier 2 of the Hockey India League 2026 at Kalinga Stadium, with Tom Boon scoring a hat-trick to seal a spot in the final.

item.title: Stubbs, Breetzke Power Sunrisers Eastern Cape to Third SA20 Title in Nail-Biting Final
item.description: Sunrisers Eastern Cape sealed their third Betway SA20 title with a six-wicket win over Pretoria Capitals at Newlands. “It was a hell of a final,” said coach Adrian Birrell after the dramatic chase.

item.title: Aus Open: Pegula Ends Keys' Title Defence In Straight Sets
item.description: Aus Open: Jessica Pegula ended Madison Keys' title defense at the Australian Open with a 6-3, 6-4 victory and sailed into the quarterfinals on Monday.

item.title: Vande Mataram’s Forgotten Cricket Connection
item.description: On the 150th anniversary of Vande Mataram, this piece explores its surprising origin in a 19th-century cricket-field incident involving Bankim Chandra Chatterjee and its lasting link with Indian cricket celebrations.

item.title: As India Celebrates 77th Republic Day, Ladakh Scouts Out There To Make A Difference In Ice Hockey
item.description: Khelo India Winter Games: There is an ice hockey revolution going on in the country to be sure, with Ladakh Scouts, a specialised mountain infantry regiment of the Indian Army, being at the forefront of it. As India celebrates its 77th Republic Day, there is no better time than this to highlight their exemplary work in the field of ice hockey.

item.title: 'IND-NZ Series Was Appetiser, Main Course Begins From Feb 7’: Gavaskar On India’s T20 WC Title Defence Preps
item.description: T20 World Cup: Former India captain Sunil Gavaskar praised Team India’s preparations ahead of their T20 World Cup title defence, noting that the Men in Blue are ‘not taking the World Cup lightly and not taking anything for granted.’

item.title: Hockey India Congratulates Savita Punia, Baldev Singh On Conferment Of Padma Shri
item.description: Hockey India Balbir Singh Senior: Hockey India on Monday congratulated Indian women’s hockey legend Savita Punia and former India international Baldev Singh on receiving the prestigious Padma Shri award, honouring their exceptional contributions to Indian hockey and sports overall.

item.title: Yuvraj, Harbhajan, Members Of Cricket Fraternity Mourn The Demise Of Ex-BCCI Chief I.S. Bindra
item.description: The Punjab Cricket Association: Former India all-rounder Yuvraj Singh, former spinner Harbhajan Singh and members of the Indian cricket fraternity paid tribute to former Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) president Inderjit Singh Bindra, who passed away at his residence on Sunday at the age of 84.
